code.note: LaWAM repository includes core model code, latent-action/world-model code, deployment, training and benchmark examples.

weights.note: Official Hugging Face collection provides LAM, pretraining and LIBERO/RoboTwin SFT checkpoints.

dataset.note: Official LIBERO and RoboTwin SFT datasets are released, while the broader pretraining data story is not represented by one complete public dataset package.

training.note: Repository includes LaWAM/LAM training code plus LIBERO and RoboTwin SFT scripts.

inference.note: Policy server and benchmark inference paths are documented for LIBERO and RoboTwin.

evaluation.note: Official repository contains LIBERO/RoboTwin evaluation scripts and run instructions.

license.note: Not yet independently audited in VLA-Radar.
